DefeatDescriptions: Your last system has fallen. The stars no longer answer to you.
The enemy consumed everything. Silence where your fleets once roared.
Overrun. Your empire exists only in memory.
The void swallowed you whole. Nothing remains but dust.
Every system lost. Every fleet gone. The galaxy moves on without you.

Conditions.Description: Eliminate all enemy fleets and capture every system.
Conditions.EndDescription: Total conquest. Every system bends to your will.
The void is silent. No fleet dares challenge you.

Conditions.Description: Capture the marked system deep in enemy territory.
Conditions.EndDescription: The distant system falls under your command.

Conditions.TimeoutMessage: Enemy reinforcements arrived. The window has closed.
Conditions.Description: Eliminate the marked faction before time runs out.
Conditions.EndDescription: The marked faction is destroyed. The stars are yours.

Conditions.TimeoutMessage: The enemy has entrenched. You failed to hold the line.
Conditions.Description: Defend the marked system and eliminate all enemies.
Conditions.EndDescription: All enemies destroyed. The marked system stands.
